The tail feathers are short and appear to form a wedge shape at the rear of the bird.

The left foot appears somewhat malformed or fused with the grass. The individual toes are not clearly defined, and the connection to the leg seems slightly ambiguous, hinting at a minor structural generation error.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the feet. Pelicans have totipalmate feet (all 4 toes webbed), which is a rare trait. AI often generates standard palmate feet (3 toes webbed). Check if the expert auditor flags the foot structure as anomalous. Also, verify if the 'smudging' on the back feathers is a result of depth-of-field simulation or actual generative artifact.
